scope: Technical extraction observations only; no qualitative or causal conclusions.

exact_adjacent_duplicate_sampled_frames.note: Exact adjacent duplicate JPEG samples were observed at the prescribed 4-fps cadence; they remain in chronological evidence and were not removed.

ball_visual_resolvability.note: In some wide and split-screen R3F frames the ball occupies only a few source pixels and is not consistently distinguishable in reduced contact-sheet thumbnails. Full-resolution 1920 × 1080 frame links preserve the available source pixels.
